title: BAQUAR BHI THE SHAREEK-E SHAHINSHAAH-E TASHNALAB
body:
baquar bhi the shareek-e shahinshaah-e tashnalab
sehraa-e karbala me uthaate rahe ta'ab
kam umr the to kya huwa majboor the ye kab
zor-e jawaa'n dikhate jo hoti raza e rab
<<MINI>>
hamjoli unke kaise lade is ladaai me
bachou ki dhaak bandh gayi tegh aazmaai me
<<DIVIDER>>
manzoor haq ko rakn-e imaamat ka tha qayaam
daftar me ousiya ke raqam ho chuka tha naam
tha hukm-e zuljalaal ye ho paanchwe imaam
qaayam rahe shariyate paighambar-e anaam
<<MINI>>
dee'n imtehaane sabr buzurgou'n ki shaan se
hujjat tamaam karke sidhaare jahaan se
<<DIVIDER>>
hamd-e quda me kat-te rahe imtihaa'n ke din
shaaker huwa qitaab-e shahinshaah-e ins-o jinn
qayam the hilm-e shaah ke sab kork-o min
har ranj me raha dil-e aagaah mutmaain
<<MINI>>
keena bhara huwa tha jo qalb-e hishaam me
takleef di bulaa ke madine se shaam me
<<DIVIDER>>
paaband hukme haakim-e jaaber tha be adab
qeemat se koi cheez na dete the hai ghazab
faaqe se teen roz raha sarwar-e arab
jis tarha karbala me uthaaya tha ye ta'ab
<<MINI>>
guzre the waa'n bhi itne hi din bhook pyaas me
dil tha hujoom-o hasrath-o andoh-o yaas me
<<DIVIDER>>
baaqer ke waaste marazul mout tha wohi
eeza-e saqt kul ke madadgaar ne sahi
taqat na uthne ki shah-e zeejaah me rahi
baqsha pisar ko aap ne roz-e yadullahi
<<MINI>>
sadma ajab tha jaafar-e saadiq ki jaan par
jaari wasiyate huwi jis dam zabaan par
<<DIVIDER>>
rone lagaa pisar jo suna ye kalaam -e yaas
shah ne kaha quda ho nigahbaan na ho udaas
rakha huwa hai jo mere ahraam ka libaas
dena kafan usi se mujhe mera haq shinaas
<<MINI>>
nahlaana apne haath se aye mahjabee'n hame
padhkar namaaz qabr me rakhna tumhi hame
<<DIVIDER>>
aawaaz deraha hai jigar gousha-e hussain
aaja ke aaj quld me hai mera noor-e ain
ye kahte kahte chup huwe sultaan-e mashraqain
laqte jigar ne aah ki aaya na dil ka chain
<<MINI>>
dekha ke haal ghair hai shaah-e anaam ka
qibla ki simth kardiya chehra imaam ka
<<DIVIDER>>
tha jinke saamne ruq-e farzand-e mahlaqaa
aankhe'n wo band hogayi andher hogaya
jo dil rubaa se kah rahe the dil ka mud'duaa
qaamoosh wo zabaa'n aye waa musibataa
<<MINI>>
kya kya tha karb jis me basar teen din huwe
bejaan chouthe roz shah-e ins-o jinn huwe
